detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

GLOW (BPC-157 / GHK-Cu / TB-500 Blend, Encapsulated Solid)

Chemical Information:

BPC-157

  • Peptide Name: BPC-157 (Body Protection Compound-157)
  • Molecular Formula: C62H98N16O22
  • Molecular Weight: ~1419.5 g/mol
  • Sequence: Gly-Glu-Pro-Pro-Pro-Gly-Lys-Pro-Ala-Asp-Asp-Ala-Gly-Leu-Val

GHK-Cu

  • Peptide Name: GHK-Cu (Copper Tripeptide-1)
  • Molecular Formula: C14H24N6O4Cu
  • Molecular Weight: ~401.9 g/mol
  • Sequence: Gly-His-Lys (copper-binding tripeptide complex)

TB-500 (Tβ-4)

  • Parent Peptide: Thymosin Beta-4 (Tβ-4)
  • Molecular Formula: C212H350N56O78S
  • Molecular Weight: ~4963 g/mol
  • Sequence: Ac-Ser-Asp-Lys-Pro-Asp-Met-Ala-Glu-Ile-Glu-Lys-Phe-Asp-Lys-Ser-Lys-Leu-Lys-Lys-Thr-Glu-Thr-Gln-Glu-Lys-Asn-Pro-Leu-Pro-Ser-Lys-Glu-Thr-Ile-Glu-Gln-Glu-Lys-Gln-Ala-Gly-Glu-Ser
  • Compound Class: Synthetic multi-peptide research blend
  • Structure Class: Peptide research complex
Description:

GLOW is a synthetic multi-peptide research blend composed of BPC-157, GHK-Cu (Copper Tripeptide-1), and TB-500 (Thymosin Beta-4). Each peptide represents a distinct structural class commonly investigated in peptide research environments. This product is not intended for topical, cosmetic, dermatological, or any human-use application. The encapsulated format serves solely as a physical containment and presentation method and does not imply any route of administration or intended method of use. GLOW is intended exclusively for controlled in-vitro laboratory research conducted by qualified professionals investigating peptide compatibility, stability, and interaction models.

Research Applications:
  • In-vitro evaluation of multi-peptide compatibility and stability
  • Laboratory investigation of peptide interaction models involving distinct peptide classes
  • Comparative analysis of single-peptide versus blended peptide research systems
  • Analytical and mechanistic studies involving synthetic regulatory peptides
Storage and Handling:
  • Store in a cool, dry environment away from direct light
  • Maintain container tightly sealed when not in use
  • Handle using appropriate laboratory safety and aseptic techniques
Product Specifications:
  • Analytical Approach to Finished Formulations: Purity is a metric used for isolated raw materials, such as lyophilized peptide powders. Finished formulations—such as capsules, liquids, and topicals—contain multiple components, including excipients and stabilizers. In these systems, a single purity value does not accurately represent the overall composition. Instead, identity and assay (content) are reported on the COA to confirm the presence of the correct compound and to verify that the labeled amount per unit is accurate. This approach reflects standard analytical practice and provides more meaningful information for research applications
  • Format: Encapsulated solid multi-peptide research blend
  • Component Composition:
  • BPC-157 — 0.5 mg
  • GHK-Cu — 2 mg
  • TB-500 — 0.5 mg
  • Appearance: light blue to pale blue solid
  • Solubility: Soluble in aqueous laboratory media following capsule removal for analytical use
Compliance Notice:

GLOW (BPC-157 / GHK-Cu / TB-500 Blend) is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
